scene: The mechanical fortune teller clatters alive inside its ornate glass case.
picture: A flat side view along the carnival boardwalk. On the far left, the painted carousel rotates with wooden mounts. In the centre, the mechanical fortune booth glows with an animatronic seer holding a crystal ball behind glass. The tall Latino man in his teal jacket stands left of centre, watching the booth.
shown: A printed white card slip sticking out from the dispenser chute centre right.
A circular brass dial set below the glass case on the far right.
The revolving carousel with painted wooden horses visible outside on the far left.
